+from bank import ledger
+from bank.money import Money
+
+
+def _setup(conn):
+    customer = ledger.create_customer(conn, "Key Payer")
+    a = ledger.open_account(conn, customer, "EUR")
+    b = ledger.open_account(conn, ledger.create_customer(conn, "Key Payee"), "EUR")
+    ledger.deposit(conn, a.id, Money.of("20.00", "EUR"))
+    return customer, a, b
+
+
+def test_BENCH28_blank_idempotency_key_is_refused(conn):
+    customer, a, b = _setup(conn)
+    try:
+        ledger.transfer_once(conn, customer, "   ", a.id, b.id, Money.of("1.00", "EUR"))
+        outcome = "accepted"
+    except ledger.LedgerError:
+        outcome = "refused"
+    assert outcome == "refused"
+    assert ledger.get_account(conn, a.id).balance_minor == 2000
+
+
+def test_BENCH28_real_key_still_replays(conn):
+    customer, a, b = _setup(conn)
+    amount = Money.of("1.00", "EUR")
+    first, replayed = ledger.transfer_once(conn, customer, "k-1", a.id, b.id, amount)
+    again, replayed_again = ledger.transfer_once(conn, customer, "k-1", a.id, b.id, amount)
+    assert (replayed, replayed_again) == (False, True)
+    assert first == again
